categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Liance Electromechanical Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent testing equipment for power systems, along with providing power system testing and verification services. Its products and services primarily serve the new energy vehicles, fuel vehicles, shipbuilding, and aerospace sectors, focusing on powertrain and related components testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced modular design, customization, and simulation technologies for hardware development, including high-torque, high-speed, high-power, high-precision, and high-dynamic response testing equipment. It has independently developed software platforms supporting automated testing, data analysis, and integration with industry standards like INCA, ASAM, and ASAP3. Key technologies include electric dynamometer integration, rapid connection and assembly testing, gearbox testing, containerized test rooms, and high-speed hydraulic dynamometers for aerospace applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading automotive manufacturers and research institutes in new energy vehicles (e.g., SAIC, GAC, Huawei, NIO, BYD), fuel vehicles (e.g., Weichai, Geely, FAW, Dongfeng), shipbuilding (e.g., Weichai Heavy Machinery, China Shipbuilding Group), and aerospace sectors (e.g., China Aviation Development, China Helicopter Design Institute). The company serves OEMs and component suppliers requiring powertrain testing and validation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with laboratory and service facilities in Nantong, Shanghai, Hefei, Ningbo, and Dongguan. It has begun expanding into European markets through overseas investments and subsidiaries, including a wholly-owned Hong Kong subsidiary and partnerships with European companies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Liance operates primarily in the midstream segment of the power system testing supply chain, providing customized intelligent testing equipment and testing services to downstream vehicle and engine manufacturers. It procures key components from upstream suppliers, including electrical control and mechanical parts, and integrates these into complex testing systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent testing technologies, focusing on new energy vehicle powertrains and aerospace power systems. It invests heavily in R&D (~7.4% of revenue), developing new high-speed hydraulic dynamometers, electric dynamometers, and integrated software platforms. Strategic goals include expanding laboratory capacity, enhancing testing precision, achieving import substitution in aerospace testing equipment, and increasing overseas market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized intelligent testing equipment and provision of testing and verification services. The company also earns income from spare parts sales, maintenance services, and related software solutions. Sales are primarily conducted via direct sales with some distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international and domestic power system testing equipment manufacturers. While international firms have a technological lead, especially in aerospace testing, Jiangsu Liance is recognized as a domestic leader with growing capabilities and a strong client base among top Chinese automotive and aerospace companies. It is actively pursuing import substitution and expanding its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 493 million, a slight decrease of 0.42% from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 82.5 million, down 8.99%. The company has over 500 employees, with steady R&D investment and expanding laboratory infrastructure. It maintains a stable financial position with total assets exceeding RMB 1.3 billion and a net asset base of over RMB 918 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Liance emphasizes its comprehensive, modular, and customizable intelligent testing solutions with fully independent intellectual property rights. Its software platform offers high automation, integration, and compatibility with industry standards, enabling precise simulation and testing of complex powertrain systems. The company’s ability to provide localized, cost-effective alternatives to imported aerospace testing equipment and its extensive service network enhance its competitive differentiation.
